The '''Blood Razor fern''' was a species of [[Fern (plant)/Legends|fern]] with [[Color/Legends|yellow-golden]] leaves.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Blood Razor fern appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'' as a housing decoration available from the Seneschal's Stronghold Pack.
